about.title: About
about.description: Learn more about me and my journey
about.intro: Hi there! My nickname is anakan, but you can call me anna. :)
about.experience: I’m a Software Engineer with 3+ years of experience in coding and this is my personal blog to share knowledge and help people.
about.journey: My journey started in Front-End, with TypeScript, React and Next.js. Since then, I’ve had the opportunity to work with Node.js/Express and MongoDB on the Back-End, Golang for auxiliary programs and more, which led me to explore other fields and possibilities.
about.learning: What I truly love about technology is simple: learning.
about.teaching: After doubting my potential to learn anything related to tech for so long, overcoming that showed me how wonderful it is to learn and teach new things, especially in tech.
about.belief: That’s why I really dislike limiting IT knowledge to one field or another.
about.work: I’m currently working as a Software Engineer.
about.study: I’m improving my skills in Golang, CyberSecurity and Cloud (AWS/GCP).
about.hobbies: I like gaming and watching movies when I’m not programming!
